entries.columnsContract: `cleanup_scope_id FK, material_handle_id, material_key, workspace_reference_id, expected_reference_revision, expected_reference_digest, control_disposition(uncontrolled|libra_owned|other_owned), expected_control_revision, expected_control_projection_digest, expected_control_owner_domain NULL, expected_control_owner_scope_type NULL, expected_control_owner_scope_id NULL, cleanup_kind(delete_or_verify_absent), state(pending|completed|blocked), state_revision, state_digest, committed_scope_state_revision NULL, deletion_effect_id NULL, outcome_evidence_schema_ref NULL, outcome_evidence_id NULL, outcome_evidence_json NULL, outcome_evidence_digest NULL, cleanup_receipt_id NULL, updated_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(cleanup_scope_id,material_handle_id)`；`rowMutability=cas_lifecycle`且只允许expected `pending→completed|blocked`；每项都保存完整available Control Projection revision/digest，uncontrolled的owner列全NULL，两个owned variant全非NULL且分别要求ownerDomain=libra或非libra；pending的committed/effect/evidence/receipt列全NULL；terminal Evidence typed JSON≤`16 KiB`，completed固定`WorkspaceMaterialDeletionEvidence@1`，blocked固定`WorkspaceCleanupBlockingEvidence@1`；libra_owned的released Control revision严格为expected+1并由historical Control row重建Receipt，other_owned不得主动删除或释放Control、只允许already-absent Evidence，blocked不得释放Reference或Control。Scope revision history由每个member唯一`committed_scope_state_revision`排序，与初始revision 1确定性重建，禁止later current row覆盖历史；`INDEX(state,updated_at_ms)`

entries.columnsContract: `product_fact_id PK, libra_run_id FK, fact_kind, fact_revision, aggregate_id NULL, schema_ref, fact_json, fact_digest, evidence_digest, source_basis_kind(metadata_observation|western_analysis|western_match) NULL, source_basis_id NULL, source_basis_digest NULL, source_ref_count, verified_artifact_manifest_schema_ref NULL, verified_artifact_manifest_json NULL, verified_artifact_manifest_digest NULL, artifact_verification_result_count, commit_payload_schema_ref NULL, commit_payload_digest NULL, event_fence_digest NULL, commit_marker NULL FK UNIQUE, result_digest NULL, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `fact_kind`必须是Catalog已注册的Product Fact kind，不由Store发明open value；Fact JSON上限`64 KiB`且大Artifact只含handle。`media_cast|product_metadata`按8.6.19固定`product_fact_id/aggregate_id/revision/commit/evidence/result`，要求全部commit/Source Basis列非NULL。Product Metadata只允许`metadata_observation|western_analysis`，且三个Artifact Manifest列全非NULL、schema固定`VerifiedArtifactManifest@1`、canonical JSON≤`256 KiB`、digest逐字节等于Manifest `manifestDigest`，`artifact_verification_result_count`等于items中去重后的显式verification Result ID数并为`0..256`；Media Cast只允许`metadata_observation|western_match`，三个Manifest列全NULL且该count=0。Observation basis的`source_ref_count=1..16`；Western Product Metadata basis为`2..17`（至少一项Analysis Result加恰一项Normalize Result）；Western Media-Cast basis恰为1项Match Result。其他已注册kind继续服从各自既有精确合同，允许这些PBF-14专用列为NULL且两个count=0，不能被本修正反向套用未定义公式；非NULL `commit_marker`显式FK到`fx_commit_markers(commit_marker)`，`ON DELETE RESTRICT`且唯一，`result_digest`逐字节等于marker所指`fx_event_result_bindings`；`UNIQUE(libra_run_id,fact_kind,fact_revision)`；`INDEX(libra_run_id,fact_kind,fact_revision)`

entries.columnsContract: `product_fact_id FK, ordinal, source_basis_kind(metadata_observation|western_analysis|western_match), work_id FK, attempt_id FK, plan_id FK, event_id FK, result_id FK, capability_ref, result_schema_ref, result_digest, source_ref, source_order, evidence_id NULL, evidence_digest NULL, input_binding_digest, reference_digest`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(product_fact_id,ordinal)`、`UNIQUE(product_fact_id,result_id)`；ordinal从0连续且恰等于Fact row的`source_ref_count`，`source_order=ordinal`，全部Work/Attempt/Plan/Event必须构成同一Run、同一Execution Basis；所有`result_digest`都逐字节复制对应`fx_event_result_bindings.result_digest=SHA-256(JCS(包含领域内digest字段的完整typed Result))`，不得复制Result内部排除自身计算的领域摘要；`input_binding_digest=SHA-256(JCS(fx_plan_nodes.input_bindings_json解析后的完整typed value))`。`metadata_observation`固定`libra.product_metadata.fetch@1 → MetadataObservation@1`，`source_ref=MetadataObservation.sourceRef`，按`sourcePriority,evidence_id`排序且Evidence列非NULL；`western_analysis`固定一至16项`libra.western.analysis.observe@1 → WesternAnalysisResult@1`后恰一项`libra.western.metadata.normalize@1 → ProductMetadataDraft@1`，observe的`source_ref=WesternAnalysisResult.resultArtifactHandle.artifactHandleId`且该Handle/digest逐字节命中同Run Artifact Registry，Evidence列非NULL；normalize的`source_ref=WesternAnalysisVariant.variantId`且Evidence列全NULL；normalize Plan input必须显式引用前序Result且最后Result逐字节等于Commit Draft；`western_match`恰一项`shared.face.reference.match@1 → PersonMatchEvidence@1`且`source_ref=PersonMatchEvidence.evidenceId`、Evidence列非NULL，其matches可为空但必须来自真实Frame→Embedding→Cluster→Match链。`reference_digest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.product-fact-source-ref@1",productFactId,ordinal,sourceBasisKind,workId,attemptId,planId,eventId,resultId,capabilityRef,resultSchemaRef,resultDigest,sourceRef,sourceOrder,evidenceId,evidenceDigest,inputBindingDigest}))`；relation存在期间所指Foundation链及Western Artifact Registry row不得GC；不得用later current Result替换历史引用

entries.constraintsContract: `on_deck_package_id=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.on-deck-package-id@1",libraRunId,packageRevision}))`，只作为由Run内唯一revision预派生的稳定身份；`package_digest`必须由完整`OnDeckProductPackage@1`按8.6.19公式重建，不能使用自选字段子集；`published_at_ms`是commit metadata且不进入该content digest；`offer_id=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.product-offer-id@1",onDeckPackageId,packageDigest}))`且唯一；run state pair逐字节引用immutable Run revision；四个manifest ID按8.6.21由run/package revision和manifest kind唯一派生，`product_fact_manifest_digest/artifact_manifest_digest/offload_context_digest`分别等于对应完整Manifest digest而不是仅成员set digest；typed JSON各≤`64 KiB`；Fact/Artifact set必须由Package relation重建，resolved-identity/media-cast Fact必须各唯一且Media Cast完整Fact JSON包含relations；`promotion_decision_digest`与Run/Workspace/Control historical rows重建值逐字节一致；`UNIQUE(libra_run_id,package_revision)`及`UNIQUE(libra_run_id,package_digest)`；Package row append-only，accepted/rejected终态只由`libra_delivery_receipts`表达；`INDEX(shelf_id,state,published_at_ms)`

entries.constraintsContract: `PK(on_deck_package_id,ordinal)`及`UNIQUE(on_deck_package_id,material_key)`；一个Physical Material在同一Product Manifest只有一个业务role，ordinal从0连续且至少一个primary，只有primary允许Episode relation；完整Physical Identity/Location/Binding/Requirement/Evidence可重建Product Material Manifest。direct input的`digest_algorithm=middle-256k-sha256,digest_hex=content_fingerprint`；系统生成Workspace output的`digest_algorithm=sha256,digest_hex`来自原写入流的独立Artifact digest且不得参与materialKey。`output_requirement_digest`必须按8.6.21从Package/Run共同引用的immutable Acceptance Spec及本Product member/relation重算并逐字节等于Manifest；assert variant固定domain location/Libra Binding，origin Delivery列全非NULL、Workspace/root-relative列全NULL且expected Control非NULL，其Physical Identity/Location/Binding/origin/expected Control逐项命中Run Input，Requirement因`manifestRole=product_delivery`按正式公式重新派生；acquire variant固定workspace location/Workspace Reference，origin/location列为NULL而root/relative及typed Handle JSON≤`4 KiB`逐字节命中current Product Staging Reference、expected Control为空并在Promotion事务取得revision 1；member/set digest按8.6.21唯一公式

`PK(on_deck_package_id,member_ordinal,episode_key)`并复合FK到Product member；只允许season primary payload；每个Material允许0..32个Episode，按episodeKey UTF-8 bytes排序；完整relation与`episode_claim_set_digest`必须按8.6.21逐字节重建，禁止只保存摘要或回读Run current scope补齐
